qb.notes: Willis remains the starter (Athlon/Rotowire Oct 18-19). He sat out bye-week throwing sessions with a minor undisclosed issue; Hafley said he expects him to be fine with no practice limitations this week. Brady Cook is on the practice squad. Pressure is mounting on Willis after an 0-5 start.

qb.notes: Nix's surgically repaired ankle (from last postseason) still bothers him per coverage, but Payton says his starting job is secure. Stidham is QB2, Sam Ehlinger QB3 (inactive Week 6, coach's decision).

GB.week6_result: Beat Dallas 23-13 on Sunday night at Lambeau (Oct 18) for a third straight win, improving to 4-2. Jordan Love converted the team's first seven third downs; Matthew Golden 6-104-1; INTs by S Evan Williams and rookie CB Brandon Cisse. No major in-game injuries reported, but DT Javon Hargrave, DT Jonathan Ford and WR Skyy Moore were all placed on IR Oct 17.

qb.notes: Love is healthy and off to a top-3 start (1,684 yds, 11 TD through six games). Backup not confirmed in search; ESPN transactions show Tyrod Taylor signed May 2026 and former backup Malik Willis now starts in Miami.
